articles.title: Amerant Bancorp Inc. Declares Dividend
articles.summary: CORAL GABLES, Fla., July 23, 2026--Amerant Bancorp Inc. (NYSE: AMTB) (the "Company" or "Amerant") today announced that, on July 22, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.09 per-share of Amerant common stock. The dividend is payable on August 28, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on August 14, 2026.
